note: 082: the agents' value table, in credits. Transcribed from docs/card-pricing.md, *Current rates* (r34); each op's row says what one unit is. Read by crates/aic-sim/src/agents/value.rs, whose match on Op is exhaustive: a new op does not compile without its arm, and a test fails until its row is here. Agent numbers, not rules: changing one changes no game's rules.

gain.per: the resource gained, at its rate

gain_per_node.per: the resource at its rate, per node (node_count when not known)

choose_player.per: the choice itself: what the other player gains is its own row

other_gain.per: the resource at its rate (a gift: they may not need it then)

transfer.per: the resource at its rate, up to max (it moves inside the team)

place_node.per: node (rates.node, node_late in the last late_rounds; +node_free if free)

clear_markers.per: marker cleared (target_share of it without a target in reach)

damage.per: the better of its kinds: ambassadors at remove_ambassador each, troops at remove_troop each

remove_ambassador.per: adversary ambassador removed in one hex (1 worth 2, 2 worth 5, 3 worth 6)

remove_troop.per: adversary troop removed in one hex

damage_country.per: a damage, in each hex of a country holding pieces (about one and a half hexes)

destroy_all.per: hex cleared of ambassadors and troops

remove_botnet.per: botnet removed (2 Sway, its compute, the block on claims)

remove_ambassadors_country.per: adversary ambassador removed in one country (max 0: token_pile), plus Sway at rates.sway

remove_troops.per: troop removed in one country: 5.5 each x 0.65 for being there

cleanse.per: station or factory cleansed; with cities, a city at liberate's row instead

liberate.per: city liberated (5 Sway and a city); no_city_share of it with no city corrupted

liberate_align.per: your cube on the liberated city

clear_city.per: adversary ambassador cleared around a corrupted city (max 0: token_pile)

move_ambassadors.per: ambassador moved up to its reach

shelter.per: country sheltered this round (conditional on a destruction)

free_building.per: building played paying no credits (a building's credits saved)

build_station.per: station built free (2 chips and about 3 cubes before its card completes)

project_cube.per: player cube on a megaproject (about 9 at completion, x 2/3 for completing)

jam.per: point of jam (x typed_jam with a source)

typed_jam.per: share of a jam that needs a threat of its type

production.per: the resource at its rate, each round left

add_tokens.per: token added, at its tokens.feed_<kind> rate

cut_botnet.per: botnet's compute skipped for a build

spread_ambassadors.per: each of your ambassadors may step (about two)

drain_all.per: compute off every visible project: 1.1 x 1.5

gain_per_tokens.per: the resource at its rate, per `per` tokens of a pile (rates.token_pile when not known)

cash_out.per: the resource at its rate, times `rate`, per token of a pile (rates.token_pile when not known)

gain_per_tag.per: the resource at its rate, per `per` tags (rates.tag_count when not known)

sway.per: Sway at rates.sway, toward Unity; against toward Discord

troops.per: adversary troop placed (each country: x countries)

corrupt_city.per: city corrupted (a liberation the other way)

lose_node_or.per: the cheaper of a node and the payment

flag.per: a round flag: against for blackout, sabotage and embargo; shelter and cordon at their rows

requisition.per: the cheaper of the cards (rates.drawn_card each) and the payment

team_income.per: the resource at its rate, each round left, for every player

pushback.per: adversary ambassador removed, in each country

infiltrate.per: adversary ambassador added, in each country

sacrifice.per: an ambassador or node each player gives up

botnet_ambassadors.per: ambassador a botnet makes (about two botnets)

clean_city_ambassadors.per: ambassador on every clean city (about four)

income.per: the resource at its rate, a round

income_per_tag.per: the resource at its rate, a round, per `per` tags (rates.tag_count when not known)

building_discount.per: credit off, a round (about a building every other round)

harden_action.per: the Harden standard action open, a round

logistics.per: the resource at its rate, a round (a counter you paid toward lands about a third of rounds)

project_drain.per: compute off each project in upkeep, a round: 1.1 x 1.5

auto_counter.per: point off a threat of its type at home, a round: about 0.3 fires x 5

unity_bonus.per: extra Sway a troop removal, a round: about 0.3 removals x rates.sway

give_bonus.per: the resource at its rate, a round

spread_shield.per: a round: about one ambassador kept off your nodes

civic_shelter.per: a round: shelter's 4 x about 0.4 destructions stopped

wall.per: a round (an AI board's innate: never on a card)

patience.per: a round (an AI board's innate: never on a card)

supply_insight.per: insight handed out, a round: 2.5 x 0.75

tags_from_hand.per: a round: a discard that pays a power

convert_upkeep.per: what the conversion nets at the rates, a round (never below 0)

city_build.per: a twist: an adversary card's, never a player's
